title: Deeper/broader 3D modeler cross-peer capability and loss-notification boundary
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local plan reconciliation
scope: Cross-check versioned DWG/DXF ACIS carrier references against current peer behavior and release evidence.
Separate modeler entity parsing, raw carrier retention, object graph association, B-rep semantics, writer disposition, and native consumer acceptance.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 implementation order while preserving fast local validation and deferring optional external qualification to a composed checkpoint.

sources.observation: ODA v5.4.1 describes the post-R2013 DWG AcDsPrototype_1b DataStorage route for ACIS; Autodesk's public 3DSOLID table describes the modeler subclass/version, proprietary group-1/3 data, and history handle. The routes are distinct and these format references do not validate arbitrary ACIS geometry semantics.
sources.limits: No local parser change, native consumer acceptance, or B-rep semantic result follows from layout documentation alone.

sources.observation: Issue #1195 reports that ACadSharp 3.4.9 reads DWG 3DSOLID/REGION entities but its DXF writer silently omits them. PR #1240 remains open and undeployed; its visible implementation commit identifies DwgObjectWriter, so it does not prove the reported DXF omission is fixed.
sources.limits: Peer issue/PR evidence is not a local reproduction, a released positive implementation, or normative format evidence.

sources.observation: Documentation states that only a limited ACIS entity set is supported, unsupported records become NONE_ENTITY with lost data, and unsupported NONE_ENTITY export raises ExportError.
sources.limits: This defines a useful fail-closed contract and limited parser behavior, not arbitrary ACIS preservation or a general geometry kernel.

sources.observation: The issue names LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at commit 8a1ae764 and describes a scratch-generatable AC1032 DXF REGION/SAB case where the entity survives conversion but its 5489-byte SAB/ACDSDATA payload is lost.
sources.limits: Reported result is version-specific and not reproduced here; it is not a current-master result or a libdxfrw defect.

sources.observation: The v0.6.5 release points to commit 289a616. Its R2018 planar-body test builds a cube from explicit vertices/faces, writes and rereads with the same codec, then asserts entity survival and nonempty ACIS data.
sources.limits: Same-codec roundtrip and data-presence assertions are transport evidence only; no independent B-rep validity, full DataStorage association, or native CAD acceptance was run here.

sources.observation: Existing PAR-07/S8 owners already cover generated DXF modeler payload/chunk checks and DWG DataIndex/Blob01 associations. The plan refinement therefore calls for reusing those owners and adding assertions only after an exact coverage audit.
sources.limits: No local code or tests were changed or run during this research-only pass.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Refined existing PAR-07/S8 into distinct gates for versioned carrier bytes, record/page association, geometry semantics, explicit writer disposition, and named-consumer acceptance. Existing local generated fast-test owners remain the per-slice validation path; an exact-pinned peer/native check is reserved for the composed checkpoint.

method.limitations: Mutable public documentation and issue pages plus released-source/test review; peer behavior was not reproduced, and no route was externally qualified.

validation.commitBlocker: Research-only plan update; no commit requested. Shared worktree contains extensive pre-existing changes and Git metadata is read-only in this session.
